exposure: inflammatory diseases of the uterus and appendages
cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women with symphysis pubis dysfunction and 50 pregnant women without the pathology, whose medical histories were analyzed.
finding: Important risk factors for symphysis pubis dysfunction are metabolic and endocrine disorders, inflammatory diseases of the female reproductive organs, repeated childbirth, and fetal weight of over 3,500 g, while ultrasound criteria for diagnosing grade I dysfunction are not reliable.
followup_time: N/A (ultrasound was performed before and after childbirth, but specific follow-up duration is not mentioned)
birth_weight: Fetal weight up to 3,500 g (grade I dysfunction) and over 3,500 g (grades II and III dysfunction)
